_readme: The highest PSA 10 values in Pokemon, from pricecharting.com.
WHAT THE NUMBER IS. PriceCharting's PSA 10 column: a price guide value
for a card graded PSA 10, calculated by their algorithm from completed
eBay sales and their own marketplace. It is NOT an auction result and
no page may describe it as one.
A SNAPSHOT. `checked` is the day the crawl ran. Every row carries the
url it came from and the page prints both, because these do not refresh
the way the nightly TCGdex raw prices do.
RANKED LOCALLY, ON PURPOSE. PriceCharting's own `sort=highest-price`
sorts by the UNGRADED price, so it cannot produce this ordering. Every
row of every set was pulled and sorted here instead. `scanned` below is
the size of the corpus that ranking was taken from.
AN EMPTY PSA 10 IS AN ANSWER, NOT A GAP. Cards with no recent PSA 10
sale have no value in this column and are absent from this file by
construction. Do not backfill them from anywhere.

excluded.name: Omastar [Masaki Promo] #139
excluded.public: its guide value moved between the two reads, so there are two correct readings of it and no basis for picking one
excluded.why: The market moved between the two reads, not a parse error. Both reads are of the same PriceCharting product record (id 5639952) and both map their columns by <th> label. The product page, read August 17, 2026, carries its own dollar change from last update of +$12,030.59 on the PSA 10 cell, and 32530.59 - 12030.59 = 20500.00 exactly, which is the figure the listing crawl of August 16, 2026 recorded. The other two columns of that page reconcile the same way to the cent: Ungraded 687.00 to 609.08 with a change of -77.92, Grade 9 2598.14 to 2547.80 with a change of -50.34. PriceCharting reports 2 sales per year in this grade for this card, so one new sale moves the guide value hard. We hold two correctly read figures $12,030 apart and no basis for calling either one the value, so the row is published nowhere.
excluded.systemic: Checked across all 400 verified rows rather than only this one, because one card moving and the parser breaking look alike from a single row. 370 rows read identical on both page types to the cent; the other 30 moved and every one of the 30 satisfies product minus its own reported change equals listing, exactly; 0 rows fall outside those two classes. The column mapping is therefore correct on all 400. Of the 30 that moved, this is the only one outside the verifier tolerance of 0.15: +58.69%, against -9.46% for the next largest, #212 Gengar #44.
excluded.effect: Excluded from publication on /top-graded.html and /base-set.html. Both builders already publish only rows whose status is agree, so this row was never printable; the entry is what lets the build continue instead of failing on an unexplained disagreement. See shared/graded-gate.mjs.
